stem: The masses, in kilograms, of large and small sacks of grain have the distributions $\text{N}(53, 11)$ and $\text{N}(14, 3)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the mass of a randomly chosen large sack is greater than four times the mass of a randomly chosen small sack.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A lift can safely carry a maximum mass of 1000 kg.

Find the probability that the lift can safely carry 12 randomly chosen large sacks and 25 randomly chosen small sacks.
